page_title: Free AI Resume Roast + ATS Score | ResumeMint

sources.entry: Resume Roaster - AI-powered resume critique with ATS scoring and keyword gap analysis. Upload your resume, get brutally honest feedback on what a recruiter sees, and identify keyword gaps against any job description. #freemium

summary.name: Resume Roaster (ResumeMint)
summary.one_liner: An AI resume critique tool that gives a fast, line-by-line honest review with an ATS compatibility score and can tailor your resume to a job description.
use_cases: Get honest feedback on a resume before applying
Check ATS compatibility of a resume
Tailor one master resume to many job descriptions
Find weak bullet points and wasted space
Identify keyword gaps against a job posting
summary.what_it_does: The page describes uploading a resume in PDF or DOCX, which is parsed into a structured master copy. A roughly 60-second AI pass gives a line-by-line review of what works and what wastes space, along with an ATS compatibility score. Users can paste a job description to generate a tailored resume variant, with each AI edit shown as a diff that can be accepted, declined, or re-prompted. The master copy is left unchanged.
notable: Diff-based tailoring: accept, decline, or re-prompt each AI edit
Master resume kept untouched while variants are generated
Parses PDF and DOCX into a reusable structured copy
caveats: Page says 'No credit counters, no per-action fees' but does not state whether any tier is paid or free; pricing is unclear
The page text does not describe keyword gap analysis explicitly; that comes from the directory listing
